note: Set A covers the IWA-wavelength trend and the UV suppression limit correctly, but it binds three science-band claims to the document title "HabEx 4-Meter Baseline Design" instead of a component, and it repeats several claims verbatim. Set B is cleaner and adds the six beam paths fact that A misses, with only two defects: it labels 0.2 µm as a "suppression band" (the text gives it as a suppression limit down to 0.2 µm in the UV) and invents the condition "nominal operation" for the 0.3–1.0 µm operating band. B omits the IWA-increases-with-wavelength statement, but overall it has fewer misbound or unsupported claims.
